doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Red Saunders and the joke about hiring a white man
summary: Asked about Red Saunders, Donegan says he gave her gigs and jokes that he had been passing for colored for years.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: I can relate to that. Did you play with Red Saunders? I think I read somewhere where you had a chance to perform at the same time Red Saunders…

Well, he’d give me some gigs you know. And I remember once, one of the ladies said, “Miss Donegan, you’re very democratic, you’re hiring a white man.” I said, “No, he’s been passing for colored for many years.” (laughs) You’re talking about Red Saunders, an oreo.
